data.name: Stories Once Told: Echoes Of Valor
data.detailed_description:
Enter the dungeon. Trust no one but your skill and knowledge.

Stories Once Told is a first-person souls-like dungeon crawler that puts tactical combat and tense exploration front and center. This demo drops you into a single, hand-crafted level. Just you, a dark tunnel, and whatever's waiting at the end of it.

What to expect in this demo:

Fight your way from entrance to exit through goblin-infested tunnels. Every corridor is a choke point, every room a fresh threat. Clear the path, unlock the way forward, and face progressively tougher enemies as you push deeper — until you reach the final chamber.

Choose your build:

Play as the Mercenary, the only class available in this demo, and pick your loadout before you descend:

  • Two-handed halberd — reach, sweeping strikes, and control over the battlefield.

  • Hammer and shield — a slower, sturdier approach built around blocking and punishing openings.

Coming in the full release

This demo is a solo experience, but Stories Once Told is being built for more. The full game will introduce multiplayer, additional classes, more dungeons, and new bosses to test your build against.

You can support us on Gamefound, where we have an active Campaign for 1 month.
